memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Hypertension: BP 148/92 mmHg, weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (>80 cm female cut-off). Plan: start amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, lifestyle salt restriction, weight goal 62 kg.
Epilepsy: known, on levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, seizure-free 6 months. Plan: continue, check serum sodium and creatinine.
Allergic rhinitis: seasonal sneezing, nasal congestion. Plan: start cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray one spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (eGFR >90 mL/min/1.73m2).
Serum potassium 4.2 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).
Serum sodium 138 mmol/L (135-145).
Total serum IgE 120 IU/mL (<100 high).
Skin prick test: positive to dust mite and grass.
ECG: normal sinus rhythm, no ischemia.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Hypertension: BP 130/82 mmHg, weight 67 kg, waist 82 cm (>80). Plan: continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, add hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD.
Epilepsy: seizure-free, serum sodium 136 mmol/L. Plan: continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Allergic rhinitis: symptoms much improved. Plan: continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD, montelukast HS.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Hypertension: BP 128/80 mmHg, weight 66 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut-off). Plan: continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, consider tapering hydrochlorothiazide if potassium rises.
Epilepsy: seizure-free, serum sodium 135 mmol/L. Plan: continue current regimen.
Allergic rhinitis: mild intermittent symptoms. Plan: continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD; stop montelukast.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Hypertension: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 67 kg, waist 81 cm (>80). Plan: continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, reduce hydrochlorothiazide to 12.5 mg every other day.
Epilepsy: seizure-free, serum sodium 133 mmol/L. Plan: continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD.
Allergic rhinitis: well controlled on cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD; montelukast remains stopped.
